# PR:139 - Weekly plugin registry update

Status: merged into `master` as `00de1dc` on 2026-07-26.

Provenance:
- Same-repository branch created by the pinned weekly scanner workflow.
- Preserved the pull request as the source of the weekly registry update.
- Updated its branch from current `master` and added two focused correction
  commits. Current head is `d5f7b31`.

Data changes:
- Release index sequence advances from 7 to 8, active releases from 44 to 48,
  and tombstones from 3 to 2.
- New active entries are `Dreame`, `Solaredge_modbustcp`, `WeatherInfo`, and
  `domoticz-kpn-experia-v10`.
- `F1_race`, `Garbage`, `HP_iLo`, `Lyrion`, `Somfy`, and `Toon_Thermostat`

- `galadril/domoticz-python-plugin-template` is now exactly blocklisted.
- `Domoticz-Python-Plugin-Template` and its placeholder identity are absent from

Assessment:
- The template is repository scaffolding, not an end-user plugin. Keeping it as
  Git-only would still expose an unusable install action, so full exclusion is
  the correct policy.
- The exact owner/repository match avoids excluding legitimate forks with the
  same repository name.
- Scanner cleanup removes a pre-existing blocked entry and its sidecar metadata
  before network discovery, and discovery cannot add it again.
- Registry binding, sequence 7 to 8 lineage, identities, tombstone reactivation,
  and every changed archive hash validate.
- The generated index expires on 2026-08-02 at 06:44 UTC.

- All 256 registry repositories passed live validation.

- Generate Plugin XML Header, Ubuntu and Windows validation, both CodeQL

Recommendation:
